# Commit Garden

Commit Garden is a web application that displays the past 365 days of public GitHub contributions as a garden.
Enter a GitHub username to view contribution counts, streaks, averages, active weekdays, and other statistics.
Open an individual garden at /u/{username}. Username entry, data retrieval, and Canvas rendering require JavaScript.
This file contains no personal activity data or authentication information. API routes and username-specific pages are not listed in the sitemap.

- [Public site and usage](https://commit-garden.snkisk.com/)

This guide helps readers retrieve public information. It does not grant additional permission for model training.
